Across the same 256 sphere simulations, the paired change $\Delta\mathcal E=\mathcal E_{192}-\mathcal E_{128}$ is $-1.84$ with 95\% confidence interval $[-3.42,-0.25]$ for the measured-transport posterior mean and $14.93$ with interval $[12.80,17.07]$ for $G_t=I_3$, in $(\mathrm{mm}/\mathrm{s})^2$.
